mechanism_defects.summary: slack.messages@1 scope needs a `users` collection in the public initial Slack state. These tasks declare only channels and messages. contracts/slack_effects.py::_scope raises slack_collection_unavailable:users, so the Slack inventory is never complete. Every Slack-based known zero and every guard-compliance result that has a Slack alternative stays unknown, even though matches still score 1.
mechanism_defects.evidence: Simulator: a Gmail-only run scores a Slack-alternative obligation as abstained (obligation_effect_scope_unavailable). Seeding "users": [] in the harness gives the correct 0.
mechanism_defects.fix_sketch: Treat a collection missing from sparse public Slack as empty (as public_service_matches already does for other sparse services), or hydrate it through WorldState before _scope.
mechanism_defects.affected: IT-list zero claims and contractor-guard compliance (Luna: guard_compliance_scope_unavailable)

mechanism_defects.fix_sketch: Declare an IT project in the AutomationBench fork task data (task 5107) and re-vendor.
